items.title: Paradise Castle
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: A paradise castle is something to dream of, but what if we could turn it into reality? On this map you can have your own dream castle and make it your own base. Explore all its secrets and rooms!

items.title: Oasis Secret Base
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: When thirsty in the middle of the desert, a mysterious oasis may appear and sometimes looking behind the waterfall a secret base can be found. Are you ready to explore all its secrets?

items.title: Secret Desert Refuge
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description: Explore this secret refuge in the middle of the desert!

items.title: Dream Team
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description: Dream in green! Mask up and earn your spot on the best team!

items.title: Master Arts
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
This world is full of surprises! So many people and so many skills! There is a master for each walk of life. A life dedicated to the mastery of martial skill and artistic styles.

+ 20 unique role-playing skins
+ Athletic attire inspired by anime!

items.title: High School Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Schools are back and it's time for teens everywhere to settle back down to class.

+ Perfect for teens going back to school
+ Awesome skins for role playing

items.title: Gamers vs Streamers
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Do you enjoy watching others immerse themselves into a game, or do you prefer diving headfirst into a brand-new world yourself? Show off your style as a trendsetting streamer or an avid video game fan!

+ 10 unique, modern skins
+ Perfect for kids and teens
+ Designed by Xenon Design

items.title: Trendy Anime Heroes
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
It's time to become a fashion icon! If you love trendy outfits and anime, this skin pack is for you! Put on a luxurious hoodie, expensive shoes, fashionable accessories, and go out into the modern city to meet your new friends! Show off to your friends and look like a character from your favorite anime. It's your time to shine!

+ 1 free skin 
+ Anime themed

items.title: Sunny Teens Style
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The new youth fashion has arrived and along with this a set of styles with warm colors! Wear the new sunny teens style skins and show them off to your friends!

+ 10 cool skins
+ By Colibri Studios

items.title: Unique Fashion
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Swap out your old style for something ultra unique! Dominate the fashion game with these new skins, you're sure to stand out wherever you go! Look your best while playing skyblock, watching anime, or become the center of any Minecraft server!

- 8 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Ink Dark
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Switch up your boring colorful outfit for a minimalistic slick one! Grab your favorite skin and be among the first to rock the stylish and clean outfits of ink dark! Play Minecraft with style and be the best you can be with these trendy skins!

- 8 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Royal Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Grab a new style with this new and fashionable pack! Pick your favorite skin and put on your crown and Become royalty! Stand out among your friends while you PVP or play skyblock!

- 8 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Blue Ice
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Switch up your fashion game from old summer to new ice. The winter is coming to your favorite Minecraft server, it's time to join up and represent the season with style! Pick the skin that best suits you and go with the flow!

-12 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Elegant Style
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Tired of the overly detailed trendy skins? Want something that is more clean and elegant, but still has charm? Then consider yourself lucky! With this pack, you will look at your best while looking slick and stylish! Just pick the color that best fits your taste and go out into the world of Minecraft!

- 8 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Fade Frenzy
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Forget about the normal boring skins and grab yourself colorful and trendy fade skins! Pick your favorite fade and follow the latest Minecraft skin trend! Dominate in your favorite gamemodes and the fashion game with style! From clean designs to crazy shapes, this pack has it all!

- 10 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Millionaires
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These millionaires are living a life of glamour and luxury! From mansions to top tier sports cars, they're living the life!

- 8 skins!
- Pick from a wide variety of skin designs and outfits! 

Which one suits you best?

items.title: Nether Dimension
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These Nether skins have come from another dimension! Featuring abstract designs, Endermen, Nether portals, and more!

- 8 skins!
- With a wide selection of designs to choose from, you can pick the one that suits your style best!

items.title: Mob Maids
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These mobs are ready to get to work! Perfect for any mansion that needs a good spring cleaning!

- 8 skins!
- Pick from Creeper, Enderman, Pig, Slime, Spider, Skeleton, Zombie, and Ghast!

items.title: Grims Dark Warriors
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: Join the eternal war for survival, with these awesome 40 skins made for battle.

items.title: Winter Fashion
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description:
Winter is here! It's time to put on that cute sweater and start the fun. Take your friends and make a snowman or even a snow castle. Decorate the Christmas tree and give presents to your loved ones. Get in the cold season mood!

- 12 winter outfits
- 1 free skin
- Created by Dragon Blocks and published by JFCrafters

items.title: Masked Teen Madness
items.creator: Meraki
items.description:
Keep your eyes peeled and don't make any sudden movements, because these teens have masked up and lurk in the shadows! Step into their shoes and use these skins for hide and seek roleplay, or just use them as a cool outfit. 

- 10 masked teen skins
- by Meraki

items.title: Animals
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Ever wanted to build a zoo? It's time to bring in the animals (hint: they're you!). Dress up as your favourite animal and let all your friends fawn over you with the Animals skin pack.

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Cat Adventurers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Are you feeling a little bit catty? If you're a cat person, then the Cat Adventurers skin pack is perfect for you! Venture around the world and claw your way through the mobs, is there a better way to do it?

- 10 skins
- Meow!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Rainbow Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Lucky blocks in all shapes and sizes... Wait, nevermind. How about lots of different colors instead?

*12 rainbow blocks
*2 skins free
